items.text:
I let it be.

Ravick is fine — he prayed once at birth, I answered then, and he has been reading the world correctly ever since: searched the camp, armored up, killed the goblin, killed the drowned man, took the **second stone out of the wall**, and then broke off the troll fight at 13 damage in and walked back to rest at the fire. Full health, no silence, no unanswered command, no stuck. He is doing the thing the valley was built for, unaided. A second voice out of the air now would only interrupt a man who is already doing well.
